questions.prompt: The schema requires a string field path. Which arguments fit it?
questions.explanation: Only this one has the required path field, and its value is a string. The others miss path or give it the wrong type.

questions.prompt: Why does the description of a tool matter?
options: The program runs the description as code
The model chooses a tool only from its name and description
The API rejects descriptions shorter than 50 characters
The description sets the type of each argument
questions.explanation: The model never sees the tool's code. It decides from the name and the description, so a clear description leads to the right choice.

questions.prompt: Your program offers 20 tools. What is one cost of that?
options: Every schema is part of the input, so it uses tokens and room in the context window in every request
The model can only use the first tool in the list
Each tool needs its own API key
questions.explanation: The tool schemas travel in every request as tokens. More tools mean more input tokens and less room for the conversation.
